leadText:
(Japanese: オヒナタウン O-Hina Town) is an -exclusive location in Kanto, situated somewhere between Fuchsia City and Cinnabar Island. It appeared in Princess vs. Princess.

It hosts the annual Princess Festival, which includes a tournament exclusively for girls, known as the Queen of the Princess Festival. entered this tournament and managed to win against Jessie and her newly during the finals.
